edges.reason: Constructor credits the full total supply to the msg.sender balance entry.
_totalSupply is copied into _balances[msg.sender] during construction.
Caller-controlled address flows through balanceOf lookup.
msg.sender is recorded as having voted in the somes mapping.
Vote tally increment is only reachable when require(!somes[msg.sender]) passes for the caller.
_candidateId indexes which candidate vote count is incremented.
candidates mapping storage is updated by the someCount increment.
candidatesCount state variable is incremented inside addSalad.
Newly built Candidate struct is written into the candidates mapping.
_name parameter string is stored in the candidates mapping.
wordsalad_ invokes addSalad for two candidate names.
shed delegates the numeric formatting to the pure helper strange.
Local result is passed to strange and returned from shed.
Local a contributes to the summed result variable.
Local b contributes to the summed result variable.
community input is copied into local loop counter j.
bytes buffer heaven is built inside strange for the decimal output.
Index k is decremented while writing digits into the buffer.
len is derived by repeatedly dividing community by 10.
rebellion.loop drives the counter increment and array push inside the unsafe operation.
The incremented counter value is pushed into the recognize storage array.
State variable j is mutated by the while loop operation.
satisfied.loop drives the do-while increment and array push.
Values appended to the appoint storage array inside the loop.
State variable satellite is incremented by the loop operation.
video.increment executes the raw num = num + 20 addition.
The unchecked addition result is written back into state variable num.
rotation.sqrt executes the unguarded exponentiation statement.
The squared value is stored back into internal_num.
eavesdrop.f performs an external state-changing call to the child contract.
External contract execution returns control to f after the low-level call.
f2 calls increment() on the externally deployed child contract.
f2 calls add() on the externally deployed child contract.
Local a is added into the local sum variable.
Local b is added into the local sum variable.
Local convention contributes to the bite arithmetic.
Local conventionconvention contributes to the bite arithmetic.
_transfer rewrites the _balances mapping using SafeMath sub and add.
recipient balance is increased by the transferred amount.
amount is subtracted from the sender balance entry.
sender address selects the balance entry being decreased.
recipient parameter flows into the internal _transfer signature.
sender parameter flows into the internal _transfer signature.
transfer delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through the internal _approve.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
spender parameter is used as the second key of the allowances mapping.
subtractedValue reduces the stored allowance amount.
increaseAllowance routes through the internal _approve.
decreaseAllowance routes through the internal _approve.
addedValue is added to the stored allowance amount.
_msgSender returns msg.sender which becomes the token sender.
_transfer is invoked with _msgSender() as the sender account.
sendValue executes the low-level value call to the recipient.
The recipient fallback function can reenter sendValue before the require succeeds.
_functionCallWithValue performs an arbitrary external call forwarding value.
An attacker-controlled target can reenter during the external call.
isContract gate is evaluated before the external call is made.
account parameter is used as the key when reading the balance mapping.
community parameter is the value being converted by strange.
_candidateId is range checked against candidatesCount before the vote is recorded.
distance is callable by any msg.sender once, gating on the somes mapping.
Local memory array data is constructed and returned by array_example.
array_example overwrites the data1 storage array literal.
The child contract instance c is used to perform external calls in f.
setName writes the name state variable of contract couple.
newName parameter is stored into the name state variable.
setAge writes the age state variable of contract couple.
newAge parameter is stored into the age state variable.
addSalad receives the candidate name argument from its caller.
owner parameter forms the first key of the allowances nested mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: newName is only consumed by couple.setName and should be folded into that setter.
newAge is only consumed by couple.setAge and should be folded into that setter.
_name exists solely to build the Candidate struct inside addSalad.
account is only used as the mapping key in balanceOf.
recipient is only consumed by the internal _transfer balance update.
amount is the operand of the SafeMath balance arithmetic inside _transfer.
sender selects the balance entry modified by _transfer.
spender is only used as the allowance mapping key in _approve.
owner is only used as the allowance mapping key in _approve.
addedValue is only used in the increaseAllowance arithmetic.
subtractedValue is only used in the decreaseAllowance arithmetic.
_candidateId is validated and used only inside distance.
community is the sole input handled by the strange converter.
Local a lives only inside video.add.
Local b lives only inside video.add.
Local sum is a temporary computed and returned by video.add.
Local convention has scope limited to demonstrator.transmission.
Local conventionconvention has scope limited to demonstrator.transmission.
Local bite is the returned temporary of demonstrator.transmission.
Local a exists only within shed.
Local b exists only within shed.
Local result is computed and forwarded to strange from shed.
Local j is a working copy of community inside strange.
Local len is the digit counter of strange.
Local k is the write index used inside strange.
Local heaven buffers the string result produced by strange.
Local data array is created and returned only by array_example.
The child contract object c exists only to perform the external call in eavesdrop.f.
